exposure: Increased amniotic fluid volume (AFV) measured by amniotic fluid index (AFI)
Increased amniotic fluid volume (AFV) measured by single deepest pocket (SDP)
outcome: Fetal overgrowth (Large for Gestational Age - LGA)
cohort: 340 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who had an ultrasound scan at term (between 37 and 40 weeks of gestation).
finding: Detection of polyhydramnios or increased amniotic fluid volume at term in women with GDM is associated with a higher risk of maternal and perinatal adverse outcomes, including fetal overgrowth (LGA and macrosomia), and a lower risk of delivering an SGA or IUGR fetus.
